originalTitle: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Global Launch Trailer
content: Take a look at the Global Launch Trailer for GTA 6, the latest entry in the third-person open-world action-adventure Grand Theft Auto franchise developed by Rockstar Games. Players can get a new look at the highly anticipated title as Jason and Lucia navigate a life of crime with romance in the mix. Explore Vice City and all Leonida has to offer in Grand Theft Auto 6, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S. #GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #Gaming
chineseContent: 请观看 GTA 6 的全球发布预告片，这是由 Rockstar Games 开发的第三人称开放世界动作冒险侠盗猎车手系列的最新作品。玩家可以重新审视这款备受期待的游戏，了解杰森和露西亚在犯罪与浪漫交织的生活中的生活。探索罪恶都市和列奥尼达在 Grand Theft Auto 6 中提供的所有内容，现已适用于 PlayStation 5 (PS5) 和 Xbox Series X|S。 #GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #Gaming
